title: Southern Star Brewing
specs: Newly renovated taproom with sleek furniture, open layout, and stylish decor including the iconic Southern Star logo.
To inquire on private events please email EVENTS@SOUTHERNSTARBREWING.COM
blurb: Guests can visit the newly renovated taproom to enjoy craft beers in a modern, inviting space with stylish decor. The taproom features an open layout and a patio. Outside food is generally not permitted except for items like birthday cake or cupcakes, but one page states outside food is welcome.
extraNote: No outside food (with the exception of items like birthday cake/cupcakes) permitted as we have an outstanding in-house kitchen and talented staff. · Outside food welcome! Have it delivered or bring it yourself and no you don't have to share with the class!
